en.joke: My last 'digital detox' was very successful. I got 200 likes on the photo of my untouched phone.
en.explanation: It satirizes the performative nature of unplugging on social media, highlighting the irony of seeking validation for 'detoxing'.

people.name: François-René de Chateaubriand
people.extract: François-René, vicomte de Chateaubriand was a French writer, politician, diplomat and historian who influenced French literature of the 19th century. Descended from an old aristocratic family from Brittany, Chateaubriand was a royalist by political disposition. He served as Minister of Foreign Affairs from 1822 to 1824 and as the French ambassador to Sweden, Prussia, the United Kingdom, and the Papal States.
highlights: Influenced French literature of the 19th century.
Served as Minister of Foreign Affairs (1822-1824).
French ambassador to Sweden, UK, and Papal States.

people.name: Richard Garcia
people.extract: Richard Garcia is an Australian soccer manager and former player. He is currently an assistant coach for Australia's U23 team, having previously managed A-League Men's side Perth Glory.
highlights: Australian soccer manager and former player.
Assistant coach for Australia's U23 team.
Managed A-League Men's side Perth Glory.

people.name: Konstantin Kalser
people.extract: Konstantin Kalser was a German-American film producer and advertising executive. He won the Academy Award for Best Live Action Short Film in 1957 with Crashing the Water Barrier.
highlights: German-American film producer and advertising executive.
Won Academy Award for Best Live Action Short Film.
Award for "Crashing the Water Barrier" in 1957.
